title: Console token reset
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `POST /api/token/reset` (`{"confirm":"reset"}`, needs the current token; 409 when no token is set) issues a new 32-char token, rewrites the `AXF_TOKEN` line of `.axf-console/env` (0600, other lines kept), closes open terminal sessions and returns the token once (`no-store`).
